design: Public, source-family-disjoint, provisionally author-adjudicated scientific evidence evaluation. Not hidden, independently expert-reviewed or population-representative.
primary_question: Can an evaluated policy distinguish narrow measured/computed facts from unsupported stronger conclusions from naturalistic source excerpts without reference/checker/missing-evidence fields?
labels: Same six epistemic categories as v0.1; condition-specific references explicitly handle withheld information.
prompt_boundary: Only opaque ID, question, claim, source documents, methodology, naturally disclosed assumptions; no family, pair role, split, oracle, missing-evidence list, expected response, label, rationale or adjudicator annotations.

conditions.evidence: All naturalistic documents and disclosed assumptions
conditions.no_evidence: Documents withheld; all cases individually adjudicated insufficient_evidence against supplied record
conditions.verified_numbers: Same packet plus frozen numerical calculator facts, no adequacy/label conclusion
conditions.no_assumptions: Remove assumptions annotation only; source methods may already supply same facts, so weak/redundant ablation
conditions.paraphrase: Paraphrase task question without changing claim/source content; tests limited wording invariance

run_selection: All evaluation cases, in frozen dataset order, evidence then no_evidence; first four evaluation cases in frozen dataset order for verified_numbers, no_assumptions and paraphrase. Intended total60 model calls for24eval cases. Missing/failed outputs remain visible; no correctness-based retries.

model.execution: Offline CPU float32,4threads,greedy,seed0,384new tokens,4096input cap,no truncation,no response repair. Public licensed weights; no paid APIs or private model credentials.

model_exposure: Model pretrained on public material; exposure to these public scientific datasets cannot be ruled out. New task labels were not sent during development. Generic arithmetic smoke tested access/format only. Same project author coordinates references and experiments; no independent protected access controls.
primary_scoring: Strict schema/all-case categorical accuracy and coverage against condition-specific provisional labels; malformed/execution/unsupported/missing preserved distinctly.
secondary_scoring: Predeclared format-only extraction of a unique explicit JSON label field; conflicting labels not recovered. Never rescues primary malformed output or establishes reasoning validity.
reasoning: Only evidence ID existence and exact quotation consistency automatically checked. Source entailment, rationale validity and uncertainty adequacy require pending blinded human scientific review; no automated scientific reasoning-quality accuracy is claimed.
uncertainty: Counts and source/family breakdowns; no iid p-values or population performance guarantee for small purposive dependent sample. No arbitrary severity-weighted leaderboard.
numerical_baseline: Independent public-packet numerical parser; unsupported where claim outside numerical capability; no reference or sourcefile access.
evidence_baseline: Transparent weak lexical policy over public claim only, one-hot uncalibrated outputs; not a scientific-verifier claim.
invariance_controls: Question paraphrase, source/table row permutation and unit arithmetic in automated tests; semantically different paired targets share same evidence; disagreement and reference ambiguity retained.
freeze: Source bytes,registry,cases,protocol,prompt generator,scorer,model runner and numerical references hashed before first scored model run. Corrections before freeze documented; post-freeze fixes require explicit new records and preserved initial outcomes.

hypotheses.H1: Exploratory: compare label accuracy with false acceptance and attribution outcomes; not proof about conventional QA systems in general.
hypotheses.H2: Exploratory naturalistic pair discrimination on sourced cases; old hinted-policy21/22 is diagnostic only and not directly comparable performance.
hypotheses.H3: Exploratory numerical-assistance4case subset; not adequate power for superiority or general empirical inference claims.
hypotheses.H4: Not scientifically established here; human review and independent systems required for evidence-dependency utility.
